fields.name: limit
fields.description: A limit on the number of roles to return. Defaults to 1000.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Cursor for pagination. Provide the value from the previous response's `next` field to continue listing roles.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order for the returned roles.

fields.name: resourceType
fields.description: Resource type the role is bound to (for example `api.organization` or `api.project`).

fields.name: predefinedRole
fields.description: Whether the role is predefined and managed by OpenAI.
